name: Kehua Data Co., Ltd.
summary: Kehua Data Co., Ltd. provides integrated solutions for power protection and energy conservation in China and internationally. The company offers critical power products; data centers comprising WiseRow, WiseAisle, and WiseAIO IDC; and renewable energy products. Its products are used in education, industry, finance, transport, health care, and data center applications. The company was formerly known as Kehua Hengsheng Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Kehua Data Co., Ltd. in January 2021. Kehua Data Co., Ltd. was founded in 1988 and is headquartered in Xiamen, China.
